evidence: Carries the Wallet label and updates option handling in src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp for fundrawtransaction and walletcreatefundedpsbt.
rationale: Fixes a bug where subtract_fee_from_outputs was silently ignored by the server and adds snake_case aliases with mutual-exclusion checks. The PR resolves inconsistent option handling across wallet funding RPCs and prevents silent misconfiguration when conflicting variants are passed.
